$schema_note: Read by production-monitor's weekly fleet dependency audit (scripts/check-fleet-dependency-audit.mjs, applyAllowlist). Every entry is a high or critical advisory this product knowingly carries because no fixed version exists. An entry matches on `advisory` (the GHSA id) AND `package`, so the same GHSA under a different package, or a NEW advisory against a listed package, is still filed. Past `review_by` the entry stops counting and the audit files the board row again. Same file and shape as ChannelMover's scripts/audit-allowlist.json, which its release gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) also reads.

entries.exception: Build tool only: in jass-tour-ui-kit picomatch is used only by the build and test tooling (Vite, Vitest, fdir, tinyglobby and @rollup/pluginutils), which matches our own file patterns with no outside input, and no fixed picomatch exists (every release up to 4.0.7, the newest, is affected); accepted by Roger 17.11.2026 (pop-up) for 30 days.
